args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and your contact email is easy to find. It could be even better with more content, such as an about section, your projects or interests, and some visuals. Nice work!

Hi Eve, I read your blog. It has a friendly, personal tone, and I like that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby. I'd enjoy seeing more of it, such as trail stories, photos, and tips. A few posts and some clear navigation would also help. Great start!

final_text:
